rationale: Adds a compact late-phase suffix-weighted training curriculum on top of the current reverse-tail recurrent baseline. It keeps the proven architecture/export path intact, but shifts late training toward the suffix positions that dominate stride-based final validation, with a small prefix floor to avoid fully discarding broader language modeling signal. The change is compile-stable, stays under the 1500-line cap, and is meaningfully different from the recent failed carry/gate variants.
title: Late Suffix-Loss Curriculum
